title: Un atelier à plusieurs horaires
titleEn: A workshop at more than one time
summary: A neighbourhood group tests a practical way to make an evening activity easier to attend.

sentences.fr: Le centre de quartier organisait un atelier le jeudi soir, mais plusieurs membres finissaient tard au travail.
sentences.en: The neighbourhood centre held a workshop on Thursday evening, but several members finished work late.

sentences.fr: Mina a proposé d'essayer deux horaires pendant un mois plutôt que de changer le programme pour toute l'année.
sentences.en: Mina proposed trying two time slots for one month instead of changing the program for the whole year.

sentences.fr: Le groupe a accepté, à condition que des bénévoles puissent ouvrir la salle les deux soirs.
sentences.en: The group agreed, provided volunteers could open the room on both evenings.

sentences.fr: Une participante qui habitait loin a choisi la séance du samedi, tandis qu'un parent a préféré le jeudi.
sentences.en: A participant who lived far away chose the Saturday session, while a parent preferred Thursday.

sentences.fr: Mina a noté les présences et demandé aux personnes absentes ce qui les avait empêchées de venir.
sentences.en: Mina recorded attendance and asked people who were absent what had prevented them from coming.

sentences.fr: Le samedi a attiré plus de monde, mais le groupe était aussi plus petit ce jour-là.
sentences.en: Saturday attracted more people, but the group was also smaller that day.
sentences.note: A small trial can inform a decision, but attendance alone may not explain why people did or did not come.

sentences.fr: Avant de choisir un horaire permanent, le centre comparera les réponses et les coûts de chaque séance.
sentences.en: Before choosing a permanent schedule, the centre will compare the responses and costs for each session.

quiz.prompt: How long would the trial last?
What condition did the group set?
options: Volunteers must be able to open the room on both evenings
Every member must attend both sessions
The Saturday session must be cancelled
The centre must hire a new coordinator
quiz.explain: The group agreed only if volunteers could open the room on both evenings.

quiz.prompt: Why will the centre compare more information before deciding?
options: The centre has already made a permanent choice
The costs are identical and need no review
The Saturday session had no participants
Attendance alone does not show the full picture
quiz.explain: The last sentences say the centre will compare responses and costs, not attendance alone.
